chapter_meta_description: Han Li and the Profound Bone Saint clash in a desperate final showdown. The unstoppable Asura Holy Flame faces its ultimate test: its own instability. A classic Mortal Stream victory is born from chaos.
og_title: The Flame That Betrays Its Master: RMJI Chapter 501
og_description: A desperate final clash! When a thousand-year-old demon’s forbidden flame turns on him, Han Li seizes the only opening he needs. The Profound Bone Saint meets his end.
twitter_title: The Profound Bone Saint is consumed by his own greed!
twitter_description: Han Li's final gambit against the Asura Holy Flame pays off when the Profound Bone Saint loses control of his own power. A spectacular and fitting end for a demon.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-tier, forbidden flame that is incredibly difficult to control and is often more dangerous to its wielder than its target if not properly refined.
A powerful Yang-aligned thunder technique released from Gold Lightning Bamboo artifacts; highly effective against demonic and ghostly entities.
A powerful ice-type flame that, when merged with the Asura Holy Flame, greatly enhances its power and can also cause it to become unstable.
A thousand-year-old ghostly cultivator who sacrificed his physical body for revenge, only to be destroyed by his own greed and unstable power.
An ancient Chinese proverb illustrating the limits of human scheming in the face of unpredictable, overwhelming cosmic or natural forces.
